card.name: Geographic coordinates and westward direction
card.fires_on: The gap or small word right before an east/west longitude value or a westward place reference, such as after a latitude in coordinates or in "west of the".

modes.label: Coordinates
modes.description: The space after a latitude, just before the longitude number and its E/W letter.
